newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli police order four PLO offices to close.
newsitem.headline: Israeli police order four PLO offices to close.

text.p: Israeli police said on Wednesday it had issued warnings to four Palestinian offices in East Jerusalem to close on their own accord within 96 hours or face forced shut down.

The warnings were being issued hours after an aide to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said it would be impossible for Israel to carry out a West Bank pullback due this week unless the four offices in Arab East Jerusalem close.
"The head of operational headquarters Yossi Levy signed letters of warning which are being handed out at these very moments," said a police spokesman.

Israel says Yasser Arafat's Palestinian self-rule Authority (PA) is conducting political activity in these offices in violation of Israel-PLO interim accords. Palestinians say the offices are not affiliated with the PA.
"It gives them 96 hours to close down. If they don't close the offices they will be shut down," the spokesman said, adding that Palestinians could appeal the decision.
A witness said police glued the warning to the door of one of the offices.

David Bar-Illan, Netanyahu's media adviser, said earlier on Wednesday that Israel intended to meet a Friday deadline to pull troops back from mainly rural areas of the West Bank but first demanded "reciprocity" from the PLO.

The 96-hour warning gave Palestinians until Sunday to appeal, two days after the due date for Israel's withdrawal. It was not immediately clear how that would affect Israel's plans. Cabinet ministers were scheduled to meet on Thursday to decide on the timing and scope of the pullback.
Palestinians said closing the offices would be a provocation.

"Although we see that these Israeli measures will cause an explosion, we are trying to save matters by contacting the Israelis and other countries to prevent this happening," said Faisal al-Husseini, responsible for Jerusalem affairs in the Palestinian Authority.

The police spokesman named the PLO offices as the Jerusalem Association for Welfare and Development, the National Islamic Committe Confronting Settlements, the Palestinian Institute for the Wounded and the Office of National Organisations.
